The cleaver has a large, rectangular, dark metal blade with visible texture and wear. The handle is dark brown, appearing to be wood or composite, with a cylindrical shape. In the background, out of focus, lies another small, dark cylindrical object, possibly a handle cap or a small tool component. The lighting creates soft shadows, highlighting the texture of the blade and the grain of the cutting board.
